verdict.rationale: Codegen's core interaction model is natural-language prompting — agents are run via prompts like "Leave a review on PR #123" through Slack, SDK, CLI, and web, and can analyze requirements, implement features, and fix bugs based on prompts. This is well documented across multiple surfaces (docs, SDK, CLI, Slack). missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration that natural-language commands work reliably in practice, and more detail on the breadth/robustness of NL understanding beyond first-party docs.
